notes: Date: 1 January 1291. Edward I holds England, the conquered principality of Wales, Gascony with the Agenais (Amiens 1279), Ponthieu (inherited by Edward of Caernarfon at Eleanor of Castile's death, 28 Nov 1290), the Channel Islands and, since June 1290, the Isle of Man.
Scotland is in interregnum after Margaret, Maid of Norway, died in autumn 1290; the Guardians govern. Berwick is Scottish until 1296.
The Anglo-Irish earldoms of 1356 (Desmond 1329, Ormond 1328, Kildare 1316) did not exist yet; the colonial lordships are part of Edward I's Lordship of Ireland.
Navarre and Champagne belong to Queen Joan I and her husband Philip IV; Champagne is modelled as part of France, Navarre as its own kingdom in personal union.
Philip IV ceded his half of Avignon to Charles II of Anjou in 1290; Avignon is Provençal, the Comtat Venaissin papal (since 1274).
The Kingdom of Majorca of James II is reduced to Roussillon, Cerdanya and Montpellier: Alfonso III of Aragon took Mallorca (1285), Ibiza (1286) and Menorca (January 1287).
Alicante, Elche and Orihuela belong to Castile until 1296; Riba-Côa (Sabugal, Castelo Rodrigo) and Olivenza to Castile until the Treaty of Alcañices 1297.
Algeciras, Tarifa, Gibraltar and Ronda are Marinid (ceded by Granada 1275); Tarifa falls to Castile in October 1292.
Gaelic rulers' names follow the Annals of Connacht and NHI IX; where the succession is disputed the ruler is left out.

states.dynasty_note: House of Plantagenet. Queen Eleanor of Castile died on 28 November 1290. Edward I is Lord of Ireland, Duke of Aquitaine and, for his son, holds Ponthieu.

summary.en: Edward I has conquered Wales and sits as arbiter of the Scottish succession after the death of the Maid of Norway.
summary.de: Eduard I. hat Wales erobert und soll nach dem Tod der Maid von Norwegen über die schottische Thronfolge entscheiden.

coa.blazon: Quarterly, 1 and 4 Azure semé-de-lis Or (France ancient), 2 and 3 Gules three lions passant guardant Or (England)

ruler.name: Guardians of Scotland (William Fraser, Robert Wishart, John Comyn, James the Steward)

states.dynasty_note: Interregnum: Margaret, Maid of Norway, died in Orkney in autumn 1290. Thirteen claimants; Edward I is asked to judge (the Great Cause, Norham 1291).

summary.en: Scotland has no king. The Guardians must choose between Balliol and Bruce, with Edward I of England as arbiter.
summary.de: Schottland hat keinen König. Die Guardians müssen zwischen Balliol und Bruce wählen, mit Eduard I. von England als Schiedsrichter.

states.dynasty_note: House of Capet. Philip IV rules jure uxoris Navarre and Champagne. Anjou and Maine were given to his brother Charles of Valois in 1290.

summary.en: The young Philip the Fair consolidates the royal domain and eyes Gascony and Flanders.
summary.de: Der junge Philipp der Schöne festigt die Krondomäne und hat Gascogne und Flandern im Blick.

summary.en: Sancho IV wants the Strait: the Marinid bridgeheads of Tarifa and Algeciras.
summary.de: Sancho IV. will die Meerenge: die merinidischen Brückenköpfe Tarifa und Algeciras.

states.dynasty_note: House of Barcelona. Alfonso III, the Liberal, took the Balearics from his uncle James II of Majorca (1285-87); excommunicated, he negotiates the Treaty of Tarascon (February 1291). He dies on 18 June 1291.
